note: Underside inspection (tools/underside.py). Off until the close-camera model (closecam.py) and the underside model (underside.py --fit) are fitted on the cell and it is switched on here; then the bottom is a required face.
radius_mm_note: TCP distances from the pan axis tried for the presentation pose (toward the close camera)
height_mm_note: TCP heights above the mat tried; the brick is lifted to the lowest before the turn
max_up_deg_note: the bottom is not turned more than this above horizontal
min_cos_note: the bottom must face the camera at least this squarely
min_iou_note: the found bottom must overlap the camera model's prediction at least this much
margin_note: chroma limit = this times the largest chroma difference of a clean bottom
